marker: # ref_size is the product length measured in the LVS assembly GCA_000009245.1 (AM233362.1) by in silico
# PCR with these primers, outer primer edge to outer primer edge. Every marker gave exactly one product.
# NEITHER THE UNIT NOR THE COPY NUMBER IS PUBLISHED IN THE SOURCE TABLE. Seven of the eleven loci are
# filled from the bundled scheme francisella_johansson_2004, which counts the same arrays in SCHU S4,
# and four are left empty. Read the warning at the end before comparing a profile with published data.
# The unit comes from two independent lines of evidence that agree. The first is a cross strain test:
# a locus keeps the same flanking length in every strain, so its product sizes must differ by whole
# multiples of the unit, and amplifying this panel in seven Francisella genomes, SCHU S4, LVS, OSU18,
# WY96-3418, FSC198, NE061598 and TI0902, gives the steps below. The second is the unit that the
# Johansson scheme derives for the same locus from a different primer pair and a different reference.
# The copy number comes from a calibration through a shared genome. The Johansson scheme states how
# many repeats its locus has in SCHU S4, and that array is the same piece of DNA whichever primers
# flank it. Measuring this scheme's product in SCHU S4 therefore gives its flanking length as the
# product minus that array, and the flanking length then fixes the copy number in LVS.
#   locus    steps seen     Johansson locus, unit and SCHU S4 count   flank   LVS count
#   Ft-M02   12             Ft-M2    6 bp   5 copies                   321     3
#   Ft-M03   9              Ft-M3    9 bp  21 copies                   245    12
#   Ft-M04   5              Ft-M4    5 bp   3 copies                   202     4
#   Ft-M05   16             Ft-M5   16 bp   3 copies                   268     2
#   Ft-M06   21             Ft-M6   21 bp   3 copies                   209     3
#   Ft-M10   256            Ft-M10  16 bp  18 copies                   166     2
#   Ft-M20A  12             Ft-M20  12 bp   3 copies                   271     4
#   Ft-M20B  one size only  Ft-M20  12 bp                              none, no cross strain evidence
#   Ft-M22   steps 6,6,19   no unit or count in Johansson              none
#   Ft-M23   one step, 23   no unit or count in Johansson              none
#   Ft-M24   steps 5,16     no unit or count in Johansson              none
# The calibration is checked two ways and passes both. Every one of the seven flanking lengths yields
# a whole number of repeats in LVS, which a wrong unit or a wrong pairing would not. And because both
# schemes then count the same array, their alleles must agree for any strain: across the five of the
# seven genomes where both panels amplify, all 35 locus and strain pairs give the same allele.
# THE SCALE IS INHERITED, NOT PUBLISHED. The Johansson counts used here are themselves derived from
# its reference rather than taken from that publication, so an allele of these seven loci is the
# number of repeats this pair of schemes counts, and it may be offset from the allele name used in
# either publication by a constant per locus. The two bundled Francisella schemes are now consistent
# with each other, which they were not before, but neither is guaranteed to match published allele
# names until a published definition table is supplied.
# THE LOCUS NAMES OF THE TWO SCHEMES DIFFER ONLY IN SPELLING. This scheme pads the number, Ft-M02,
# where francisella_johansson_2004 does not, Ft-M2, and the agreement above confirms the padded and
# unpadded names are the same VNTR. Ft-M20 there is split here into Ft-M20A and Ft-M20B. The two
# still amplify different fragments, so their product sizes are not comparable even though their
# alleles now are.
